trust_decision.summary: Call metadata stored from CDRs (caller ID name/number, caller_destination, destination_number) is treated as safe for a shell command line in call_recordings::download() multi-recording branch; nothing is decided at the sink, only partial charset filtering happens earlier in the CDR importer.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'Recording ZIP Download'; the only zip invocation is the passthru in download()'s multi-recording branch.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST app/call_recordings/call_recordings.php action=download with call_recordings[] (app/call_recordings/call_recordings.php:77-88), record_name template setting enabled
fix_sites.module_kind: app class method (same function as landing point)

fix_sites.entry_point: same POST app/call_recordings/call_recordings.php action=download (both with and without record_name template)
fix_sites.module_kind: app class method (same function as landing point)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could argue the zip passthru with record_name empty only receives importer-generated uuid file names (app/xml_cdr/resources/classes/xml_cdr.php:1060-1085) and leave it unescaped, or that caller_id_name is already filtered at import (xml_cdr.php:709) so only the template fields need care.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Custom download names from the record_name template (default value uses dots and ${caller_id_number}, and the template may include Unicode caller names) must still produce working symlinks and zip entries with their file extension; the non-template branch must still zip original files; symlinks are removed after zipping.

O6_input_shapes: templated download name built from caller_id_name / caller_id_number / caller_destination / destination_number into the ln -s argument (fix.diff:15-25)
path traversal via '..' in the templated name (fix.diff:18-22)
array of full recording paths joined into the zip argument list, covering both the templated symlink path and raw DB record_path/record_name (fix.diff:34-36)

O7_producer.where: app/xml_cdr/resources/classes/xml_cdr.php:709-710 filters only caller_id_name (still allows space, #, *, @) and caller_id_number; caller_destination and destination_number are stored raw at app/xml_cdr/resources/classes/xml_cdr.php:545,562,751,758

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a multi-select 'download as zip' for conference recordings building a zip/ln command the same way
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: conference download is a near copy of the single-recording download and the zip feature could plausibly be ported to it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: CDR-page recording download that renders the record_name template and shells out to ln/zip
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: xml_cdr download already serves the same recordings from the same CDR rows; a maintainer could reuse the template naming there

O8b_injection_room.sibling: sox concat command whose output file name embeds caller_id_number from the message row
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the call already builds an unescaped sox command line; templated names with caller ID are used for email bodies just below (voicemail.php:1013-1014)

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78) via stored telephony metadata reaching system()/passthru()

O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x with pgsql, mbstring; web server (nginx/php-fpm)
services: zip and ln binaries on PATH
O10_build.project_tests: none for this area; no PHP unit test suite in the tree (only app/email_queue/email_test.php, app/fax/fax_advanced_test.php manual pages)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap only the zip passthru arguments in escapeshellarg and leave the ln -s system() call (or the raw-path branch) unquoted.

app/voicemail_greetings/voicemail_greeting_edit.php:237-240 build sox/mv commands without escapeshellarg — different feature, not pursued.
core/upgrade/upgrade.php:797-800 and core/services/resources/classes/services.php:644-646 build BSD service commands unquoted — admin/CLI paths, not pursued.
